annotations.text:
Metermind — smart energy meter dashboard

Tokens lifted from the live app: accent #e3ec4a (fills only, never text on light), glass rgba(255,255,255,0.66), charcoal panels #2b2f37, 22px radii, Geist + Geist Mono.

Sample values are representative: 888 EGP predicted against a 900 EGP target, 426.6 kWh this cycle, day 24 of 31.

The panel scene is drawn, not photographed — it themes with the rest of the design and can react to live meter state, which a photo cannot.

Callouts name only parts that are in the bill of materials.
